Elvis Costello & The Attractions – Punch The Clock (1983)

A classic 1980s Elvis Costello release featuring some of his most recognizable songs including "Everyday I Write The Book" and "Shipbuilding." Produced by Clive Langer and Alan Winstanley and backed by The Attractions with contributions from the TKO Horns.
